controls.source_trace: Dependency/config -> decision return/error -> authorization fallback -> mutation.
controls.controlled_verification: Inject timeout/None/error in a local stub and inspect state.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: 503 alone is not proof no mutation occurred.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Unknown permission never grants the protected capability; legitimate decisions still work.

controls.controlled_verification: Exercise an absent feature and a supported-feature control locally.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A healthy configured branch does not cover absent configuration.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Unsupported selection rejects safely without panic or insecure fallback.

controls.source_trace: State update -> durable commit -> outbound side effect -> response.
controls.controlled_verification: Inject failure before/after a disposable commit boundary and inspect ledgers.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Lost response after a successful commit is not rollback.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Atomicity or documented compensation restores the required business/security invariant.

controls.source_trace: Principal/operation/request fingerprint -> idempotency key -> unique result.
controls.controlled_verification: Repeat the same operation, then attempt conflicting reuse on controlled data.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Same string key with different actor/body is not the same operation.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Same request reuses one result; conflicting reuse rejects; workers enforce atomic uniqueness.

controls.source_trace: Resource acquisition -> exception/cancellation -> cleanup -> next request.
controls.controlled_verification: Use bounded disposable resources and explicit local cancellation/failure.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Do not demonstrate leakage by exhausting live service resources.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Resources and transactions reach the intended state and a later valid request succeeds.

controls.source_trace: Typed failure -> retry eligibility -> backoff/budget -> secure degraded mode.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a deterministic stub to count attempts and observe final state.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Retrying a non-idempotent effect can worsen the incident.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Attempts are bounded and justified; final behavior preserves the security decision and recovery contract.
